title: PocketHouse
description: A pocket dimension mod with a house that can be customized to accommodate mobs. Crafting is easy and balanced, with 1 bag and 8 eye enders around the bag in a workbench.
body: PocketHouse Mod introduces a unique pocket dimension bag that lets you carry your base in your pocket. The house is fully customizable and spacious enough to accommodate various mobs. The crafting recipe is simple yet balanced for survival: place 1 bag in the center and surround it with 8 Eyes of Ender in a workbench. Create your mobile farm, a safe shelter, or a portable laboratory. Explore the world without limits, knowing that your cozy home and loyal mobs are always just one click away in your inventory!
